Who We Are:

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

  • Seek Excellence.
  • Be Selective To Be Effective.
  • Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.
  • Disagree Transparently.
  • Encourage Independent Decision-Making.

The Galaxy NYC Summer Internship Program is an immersive, nine-week experience taking place on-site in our New York HQ office. During the nine weeks, you will gain hands-on, practical work experience on our Finance (Treasury) Team, working on real products and problems alongside the people building them. In addition to learning on the job, Galaxy interns participate in professional development programming, social events, and networking opportunities with senior leaders.

Program Dates: June 7th – August 6th, 2027

  • Assist with managing Digital Assets Treasury’s Inventory and optimizing yield on idle balances.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Institutional lending & Trading) and analyze their exposures and capital needs.
  • Prepare and present trade pitches.
  • Assist in preparing presentations, dashboards, and data models to inform strategic and operational decisions.
  • Help streamline finance and operations processes through automation, analytics, or process improvements.
  • Assist with daily/weekly liquidity reporting for senior management.

What We're Looking For:

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with proficiency in Excel; familiarity with SQL, Python, or BI tools is a plus.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and time management.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present financial insights clearly.
  • Self-starter attitude with the curiosity to learn and the initiative to take on new challenges.
  • Available to work in-person in our New York office during the internship term.

  • Undergraduate or master’s students graduating between December 2027 and June 2028
  • Eligible master’s students must have fewer than two years of relevant, full-time work experience

  • Opportunities to learn about the Digital Asset and Data Center industry
  • Free daily snacks and weekly lunches
  • Smart, entrepreneurial and fun colleagues

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Our AI team builds the models, agents, and platforms behind Robinhood's products and the tools our employees use every day. We work in small groups where product, engineering, and research sit together and ship in weeks, not quarters. We partner closely with design, data science, legal, and compliance, because financial products need to be useful and safe. We value clear writing, direct feedback, and decisions backed by data. It's an exciting time to join us!

As a Staff Product Manager, AI, you will set the product direction for a core AI area, from the first problem statement through launch and measurement. You will decide which problems are worth solving, write clear specs, and define how we know a model or agent is working, including quality, speed, cost, and safety. Every day, you will work with engineers, researchers, designers, and data scientists to turn early prototypes into products customers trust. You will also coach other product managers and raise the bar on how the team plans and evaluates AI work. We can't wait to see what you build!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for an AI product area, and explain the plan clearly to senior leaders in writing and in person
  • Turn open-ended problems into specs with goals, success metrics, and launch criteria
  • Define how AI features are evaluated, including accuracy, response time, cost per request, and safety, and work with engineers and researchers to improve each one
  • Ship in small steps with engineering, design, and data science, and learn from how customers use each release
  • Partner with legal, compliance, and security so AI features meet financial regulations and Robinhood's standards
  • Track product metrics and run experiments, then use the results to decide what to build, change, or stop
  • Mentor other product managers and help set shared standards for AI product work

What you bring

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years shipping AI or machine learning products, such as features built on large language models, agents, recommendations, or ML platforms
  • A track record of taking a product from idea to launch and growing its use, with results you can describe in numbers
  • Working knowledge of how large language models are built, evaluated, and deployed, and the ability to discuss tradeoffs with engineers and researchers
  • Strong written communication, including explaining technical choices to people outside engineering
  • Comfort with data, including SQL or a similar tool, experiment design, and metric definition
  • Experience leading work across several teams without direct authority
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have:

  • Experience in fintech, brokerage, payments, or another regulated industry
  • Experience building AI agents or internal AI platforms

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well... build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

We are looking for someone to own institutional communications as Kalshi expands its presence with institutional investors.

You’ll develop our communications strategy, build relationships with financial and industry reporters, and drive media coverage alongside our institutional team and agency. We’re looking for a strong writer who understands exchanges, clearing, or derivatives trading and brings creative ideas, sound judgment, and the drive to own strategy through execution.

What You'll Do

  • Own Kalshi’s institutional communications strategy, identifying the audiences, outlets, and stories that matter most

  • Build relationships with reporters covering institutional markets, derivatives, exchanges, clearing, and trading

  • Proactively pitch stories that build Kalshi’s visibility and credibility with institutional audiences

  • Write press releases, media pitches, executive talking points, bylines, and other communications materials

  • Work closely with our institutional team to turn business developments and complex market topics into compelling stories

  • Partner with our agency to develop campaigns, coordinate outreach, and secure meaningful coverage

  • Use feedback from reporters and institutional audiences to sharpen our messaging and approach

What We're Looking For

  • Based in New York City

  • Mid-level communications or public relations experience in exchanges, clearing, trading, or financial market infrastructure, either in-house or at an agency

  • Strong understanding of financial markets and derivatives trading

  • Excellent writing skills and the ability to make complex financial topics clear and compelling

  • Strong financial media relationships and a track record of securing coverage

  • Creative instincts, thoughtful judgment, and the confidence to challenge conventional approaches to financial communications

  • The ability to build trust with executives, colleagues, reporters, and agency teams

  • A willingness to take responsibility and independently own work from strategy through execution

Bonus Points

  • Experience building a communications program for a new business or audience

  • Experience developing executive thought leadership and securing coverage in both institutional trade publications and broader financial media

  • Familiarity with prediction markets and their applications for institutional participants

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure

Salary Range: $130,000 to $220,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we’re always happy to discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big... but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Description

We’re looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Recruiting Coordinator to support our recruiting team as we scale the organization. In this 6-month contract, you’ll be owning interview logistics, keeping candidates informed, and helping us deliver a best-in-class candidate experience across technical and non-technical roles.

This is a great opportunity for someone with coordination experience who wants to deepen their recruiting skills in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.

Contract Details

  • Duration: 6 months with possibility to extend

  • Schedule: 40 hr. work week

  • Location: ideally based in San Francisco, CA or New York City, NY

What You’ll Learn

  • You will learn how to run end-to-end recruiting coordination for a high-growth startup & across multiple teams.

  • You will get experience partnering with recruiters and hiring managers across multiple functions.

  • You will learn foundational sourcing skills, including building top-of-funnel pipelines and using tools like LinkedIn Recruiter and Covey.

  • You will observe how to track and analyze core recruiting metrics (pipeline health, conversion rates, time-to-hire).

  • You will develop best practices for maintaining clean ATS data and creating simple reports/dashboards.

  • You will be able to deliver a best-in-class candidate experience through clear communication and strong logistics.

Responsibilities

  • Assist recruitment team by coordinating and scheduling interviews throughout all stages of the interview process, ensuring a positive and professional interaction for potential hires.

  • Assist with additional scheduling of internal team meetings, candidate debriefs, and others as needed.

  • Act as the ATS administrator in Ashby handling all system management, own LinkedIn admin and other recruiting tools, and oversee all Notion database management and maintenance.

  • Package a weekly Recruiting progress report for the Executive leadership team.

  • Partner cross-functionally to identify areas for improvement within recruitment activities to continuously improve process.

  • Serve as the main point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, answering questions, providing timely updates, and setting clear expectations to deliver a warm, professional, first-class experience with Phantom.

  • Help maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate data in our ATS.

  • Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand role requirements and keep interview processes moving smoothly.

  • Proactively flag bottlenecks and help unblock processes so candidates move efficiently through the funnel.

  • Support occasional recruiting events.

Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of coordination experience (e.g. recruiting coordination, office coordination, executive assistant, operations, or similar role with heavy scheduling/logistics).

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent).

  • Preference to work out of our San Francisco or NY office at least 2 days per week if local to those areas.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills; comfortable juggling multiple requests and changing priorities.

  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication with candidates and internal stakeholders.

  • Comfort working with tools like Google Workspace & Notion.

  • Must be highly organized, efficient and process driven.

  • Excellent at anticipating needs and creating structure out of ambiguity.

  • Exceptional critical thinker who can tackle complex problems, is quick to respond and has a high attention to detail with little to no error.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth tech company.

  • Hands-on experience with an ATS such as Greenhouse, Lever, or Ashby.

  • Increase speed and leverage

Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

As CDD Analyst at Augustus, you own customer due diligence end to end, from onboarding through periodic and event-driven reviews. You run CIP/CDD on individuals and legal entities, assign customer risk ratings, and run EDD on high-risk customers, complex ownership structures and FBO relationships. You prepare those cases for the High-Risk Customer Review Committee. You report directly to the Deputy BSA Officer.

We’re building an AI native bank, which is designed to run mostly autonomously. Legacy banks scale KYC with people. We scale it with agents, supporting human decisions. You improve the prompts of our review agents, and you work with Engineering and Product to automate onboarding within our regulatory bouunds. Your judgment sets the standard the agents follow. The goal is to make routine cases disappear so your time goes to the ones that matter.

Your First Six Months

  • Months 1-2: Work the queue yourself. Onboard individuals and legal entities end to end: CIP, document review, beneficial ownership certification and risk rating. Learn the Bank’s CRR methodology well enough to see where it’s unclear and where the review agents get it wrong.

  • Months 3-4: Own EDD on high-risk customers, complex ownership structures and FBO relationships. Your cases go to the High-Risk Customer Review Committee ready for a decision, with no rework needed. You’re rewriting agent prompts based on what you see in the queue.

  • Months 5-6: Agents handle standard onboarding and periodic reviews. You take the hard cases, event-driven reviews and exceptions. You work with Engineering and Product on the next onboarding flows to automate, within limits set by Compliance.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You reason from first principles. You ask what risk a check covers before you run it, and you drop the steps that don’t cover anything.

  • You don’t trade off customer experience. A clean onboarding is part of good CDD, and you never ask a customer for the same document twice.

  • You challenge how things are done. If a process is slow, redundant or wrong, you say so, also upwards, and you bring the fix.

  • You’re diligent. Your files are complete, your reasoning is documented, and they hold up when someone checks them.

This role is not for you if:

  • You want a fixed checklist and a stable process. Ours changes every time the agents get better.

  • You see automation as a threat to your job. Here it is the job.

  • You treat CDD as box-ticking. An examiner may read every rating you set.

  • You need someone else to tell you a file isn’t good enough.

Hard Requirements

Pay transparency

What We Offer

About the role

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market, and trust in every account, deposit and trade is core to the product. As Head of Fraud, you will own Polymarket's fraud risk end to end: defining the strategy, building preventative and detective controls, and making sure every finding is resolved.

Your scope covers first-party fraud (customers abusing the platform themselves) and third-party fraud (bad actors targeting our users and systems, including account takeover). You will hold the bar for what good looks like both commercially and in the eyes of our regulators, and you will move fast.

You will partner with and influence Product owners and engineers you don't manage build and ship most fraud controls, so influencing them is critical to success in this role. You'll also work closely with Compliance, Legal, Data, Payments, Customer Support and Security.

What you'll own

Strategy and risk ownership

  • Own the fraud risk framework and appetite, and set the roadmap to deliver it.

  • Maintain a living fraud risk assessment and typology library across onboarding, funding, trading and withdrawals.

  • Report fraud exposure, losses, control performance and emerging threats to senior leadership and governance forums.

Preventative and detective controls

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to assess fraud risk before new products, payment methods, promotions, and material feature changes launch.

  • Define and implement controls that stop fraud before it happens: identity and device signals, step-up authentication, velocity and limit rules, and payment and withdrawal checks.

  • Build detective controls that surface fraud fast: monitoring rules, ML and AI models, anomaly detection, alerting and case management.

  • Tune controls continuously against loss rates, false positives and customer friction.

Fraud types in scope

  • First-party fraud: chargeback and friendly fraud, promotion and referral abuse, ACH fraud, multi-accounting, and identity misrepresentation by genuine customers.

  • Third-party fraud: account takeover, synthetic and stolen identities, stolen payment methods, phishing, social engineering, scams, and organized fraud rings.

Findings and resolution

  • Own investigations, from triage to root cause to closure.

  • Make sure every finding from monitoring, audits, regulatory exams and incidents has an owner, a fix and a deadline, and is closed out.

  • Feed lessons back into product, controls and policy so issues don't recur.

Team and partnership

  • Build and lead a high-performing fraud team of analysts, investigators and fraud data specialists.

  • Drive delivery through Product and Engineering: shape their roadmaps, win prioritization for fraud work, and design prevention into features from day one.

  • Work with Compliance and Legal on regulatory expectations, SAR-related escalations and exam readiness.

  • Select and manage fraud vendors and tooling.

What we're looking for

Influence is the most critical skill for this role, and we'll assess it at every interview stage.

  • Breadth across fraud types. Hands-on experience with both first-party and third-party fraud, including account takeover, identity fraud and payment fraud.

  • AI native. You use AI and automation as your default way of working: for detection models, investigation tooling, case triage and your own day-to-day productivity. You know where models beat rules and where they don't.

  • Commercial judgement. You understand that the goal is the right balance of loss, friction and growth, not zero fraud. You can put a number on the trade-offs.

  • Regulatory lens. You know what regulators expect from a fraud program (governance, documentation, testing, escalation) and can defend our approach in an exam.

  • Pace and ownership. You drive outcomes quickly, prioritize ruthlessly and close things out. You're comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

  • Data fluency. Comfortable working directly in SQL and with data teams to size problems and measure control performance.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a regulated exchange, derivatives venue or broker, or at a crypto platform with on-chain and fiat flows.

  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics and wallet-level risk signals.

  • Exposure to market abuse and trade surveillance, and how it intersects with fraud.

  • Experience building fraud capability across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM or agent-based tooling for investigations.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

Pay Transparency
